The H1(V) cokernel equals its kernel in cardinality and is bounded by the exact scalar graph/Jacobian filtration.

The coefficient action is q0 times inverse geometric deck pullback, explicitly distinguished from the k-linear action on roots of unity.
The exponent 4pg+3v is O_R(ta) and q0^a=q. Thus the full field-cover degree is absorbed.
The usual group-to-scheme degree-two injection is justified for the nonconstant finite sheaf by the universal-cover torsor argument.
The final remark measures geometric period only after the field-kernel cover, where the band is constant.
